name: Split button
purpose: A two-target action control: a MAIN action button that fires immediately, glued to a CARET trigger that opens a menu of alternative/related actions. PROPOSED #209 (itinerary row 6, slug split-button) — NOT GATED, NOT RULED. A Button + Dropdown composition, per the wave-3 brief: the main/caret pair reuses Button.reference's tokens verbatim, and the flyout reuses Dropdown.reference's `.menu` shell verbatim, with role="menu"/"menuitem" replacing role="listbox"/"option" because a split-button menu triggers ACTIONS, not a value selection.
when: actions >= 2 AND interrupts = none — one main action plus a menu of related ones, offered in place (button's own `when` already hands this case here); beats modals whenever the related actions can be offered without stopping the person.

props.name: label
props.$note: Visible text on the MAIN action button, e.g. 'Send payment'.

props.name: tier
props.$note: Mirrors two of Button's four emphasis tiers. Secondary/quaternary were not authored into this specimen — unproposed, not excluded; see antiPatterns/decisionsForDave.

props.name: items
props.$note: Menu entries, each { label } for now — no icon slot authored (see decisionsForDave).

props.name: disabled
props.$note: Disables BOTH halves in lock-step — a split button cannot be half-disabled.

variants.name: primary
variants.use: The main action IS the primary action of its context (e.g. 'Send payment' with 'Schedule for later' as an alternative).

variants.name: tertiary
variants.use: A lower-emphasis split action (e.g. 'Export' with format alternatives) that should not compete with a page's real primary button.

tokens.main: button.primary.{background,label}.* / button.tertiary.{label,border,background-hover}.* — copied byte-for-byte from Button.reference's own tiers
tokens.caret: same tier tokens as the main half; the divider between them is color-mix(in srgb, <tier label token> alpha.24, <tier background token>) on the primary tier, or the tier's own border token on tertiary — NO NEW HEX MINTED
tokens.menu: background.default (surface) / elevation.border (dark outline) / elevation.functional (light shadow) / form.background.hover (item hover) / divider.border.section — copied byte-for-byte from Dropdown.reference's `.menu`/`.opt` shell
tokens.radius: border-radius.control (both button halves) + border-radius.surface (the flyout panel)
tokens.motion: component-type.button-family.press-travel / press-darken — the same B-D7 pixel-true partial as Button and Icon-button
tokens.$note: NO NEW TOKEN IS WANTED OR MINTED (payment-card-visual's tokens.$note standard, copied). Every value already exists and is already bound by a gated component.

motion.hover: Scale-physics grow, identical to Button (B-D7 pixel-true, --phys-size 120).
motion.press: Scale-physics recede + darken, identical to Button.
motion.menuOpen: opacity + translateY(-6px)->none over --ease, copied from Dropdown.reference's `.menu` open transition.
motion.reducedMotion: Transforms/filters disabled under prefers-reduced-motion; the menu's opacity fade is retained (not a scale/translate hazard).

responsive.rule: Intrinsically fixed-width (label-driven main + 44px caret); does not itself reflow. In an action-bar (Button's responsive unit), a split button behaves as one atomic item — it does not split its two halves onto separate rows.

mustNotNeighbour: A second split button with an overlapping/ambiguous main action in the same toolbar
commonPatterns: primary action + alternative actions (send now / schedule / save as template)
bulk row action with a default + alternatives

accessibility.role: The main half is a plain <button>. The caret half is a SEPARATE <button> carrying aria-haspopup="menu" + aria-expanded, aria-controls pointing at the flyout, and its own aria-label (e.g. 'More payment actions') because it has no visible text.
accessibility.menu: The flyout is role="menu" with role="menuitem" children — the WAI-ARIA APG 'menu button' pattern, deliberately NOT role="listbox"/"option" (Dropdown's pattern), because menu items are actions, not a selectable value.
accessibility.keyboard: Caret: Enter/Space/ArrowDown opens and focuses the first item. Within the menu: ArrowUp/ArrowDown cycle, Escape closes and returns focus to the caret. Click-away closes. Main button: Enter/Space fires immediately and does not open the menu (see decisionsForDave on whether ArrowDown on the main button should also open it).
accessibility.focus: Each half has its OWN visible focus-visible ring (focus.ring); the outline gets z-index:1 so it is not clipped by the sibling button's adjoining edge.
accessibility.target: Main >=44px tall, label-driven width; caret exactly 44x44 (2.5.8).

antiPatterns: Making the caret and main action share ONE <button> / one click handler — they are two independently operable controls with two accessible names.
Using role="listbox"/"option" for the flyout (that is Dropdown's value-selection semantics, not this component's action semantics).
Disabling only one half of the pair — disabled must apply to both in lock-step.
Putting the PRIMARY action inside the menu and a lesser action as the main button (inverts the hierarchy the control exists to express).
REVIEW (inferred): stacking two split buttons with overlapping menu items in the same toolbar (ambiguous which 'main' applies).

tokenValidation.result: PROPOSED — worker lane render-verify only (light+dark, headless Chromium, 0 console errors). _validate_snippets.py / _validate_a11y.py / _validate_type_composites.py / _validate_grid.py / _validate_radius.py NOT RUN by this lane (conductor's serial set, per the wave-3 brief). This is a PROPOSAL, not a proof-of-done.
tokenValidation.$note: Not registered in component-types.json (shared file, outside this lane's fence). Not in _validate_radius.MIGRATED_SNIPPETS. No .cn-split-button scope exists in canon.css.

$differsFrom.Button: Button is a single-target control — one action, one accessible name. Split button is TWO independently operable controls sharing one visual boundary.
$differsFrom.Dropdown: Dropdown SELECTS a value from a closed set (role="combobox"/"listbox"/"option", aria-selected persists). Split button's caret opens a menu of ACTIONS (role="menu"/"menuitem", no selected state — choosing an item performs it and closes the menu, it does not change what the main button says).

$decisionsForDave: Should ArrowDown on the MAIN button also open the menu (a common APG variant), or should only the caret open it (as built)?
Should a menu item optionally carry a leading icon (some Table row-action menus do)? Unproposed here, flagged only.
Only primary + tertiary tiers were specimen'd. Should secondary/quaternary split buttons exist, or is split-button reserved for higher-emphasis actions only?
The primary-tier divider hairline reads faint by design (alpha.24 over the fill) — is that the right visibility, or should it bind a stronger existing token?

mustNotNeighbour.$note: A second split button with an overlapping/ambiguous main action in the same toolbar

states.$keys-source: key names read from the snippet's script; action words are the APG defaults for those keys, not read from the snippet

expanded: attribute aria-expanded on body > div.row > div.split-btn.primary > button.sb-caret
open: attribute data-open on a twin of body > div.row > div.split-btn.primary > ul.sb-menu

$extracted.$emits-note: the snippet dispatches no CustomEvent, so `emits` is the positive empty list; what the part should fire is Dave's call on the review page
